'''Mathias Knoll''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Berlin tournament]] on 12 May 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM with Emperor's Power]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS with inserts]], according to Alexander Schwarz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2319">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-17-berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-returnd2319/ berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-return], DeckTech (Alexander "Black Leader" Schwarz, 17 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-17-berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-returnd2319/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
